stated_direction.D-1 (holds): every missing tier-1 process and every missing electron-impact excitation of a configured neutral (HA-O-EL-01, HA-O-EXC-01, HA-O-EXC-02, HA-O2-EXC-01, -02, -03, HA-O2-VIB-01, HA-O2-ROT-01, HA-O2-DIS-01 below 13.5 eV) is an electron-impact channel with a non-negative rate and a non-negative energy loss or momentum transfer. At any given plasma state (n_e, T_e and neutral densities) the set's electron inelastic power, its electron-neutral momentum-transfer frequency of O, and its O2 dissociation rate are therefore LOWER BOUNDS of those of a complete electron-impact set. Each configured process keeps its own unweighted source pair.
stated_direction.D-2 (no direction claimed): no direction is claimed for omitted processes that create ions or change the ion mix or the neutral composition: stepwise ionization from metastables (HA-MS-01, which would add ionization), multiply charged O (HA-O-ION-02/03, HA-O2-DI-02), heavy-particle and N / O cross chemistry (HA-IM-01, HA-HN-01; L-01), channel-wall recombination (HA-WALL-02/03; L-02), attachment and recombination (HA-O2-ATT-01, HA-DR-01, HA-REC-02; L-04 / L-05).
stated_direction.D-3 (no direction claimed): no direction is claimed for any Hall observable (thrust, discharge current or power, ionization fraction, efficiencies): HallThruster.jl is nonlinear in the electron energy budget and the anomalous transport, and no monotonicity in the omitted losses has been shown. D-1 is a statement about the chemistry inputs at a fixed state, not about the solution.

bounding_variant_set.use: a labelled one-sided bounding variant for the AIR family of NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE (prereg addendum A1 bounded launch path); every record and every derived quantity carries the label; results are information, never a closure (SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS) and never a non-closure (PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING) on their own (classification effect fixed in addendum A1)
bounding_variant_set.upgrade_path: the v1 admission path: acquisition of the tier-1 sources (OQ-HA-05), the SONG2026 version-of-record check, species bounds, the audit verdicts; BV-AIR-LL is then superseded, never relabelled
